entries.outcome: The example estate remains a sovereign, useful, private, and cost-disciplined small-scale cloud.
The organisation has a stable self-hosted platform that is controlled end to end.
Organisational data has a known home, classification, retention idea, and restore path.
Personal and organisational activity is not exposed as a routine price of hosted features.
Chosen service classes provide useful, replaceable, cloud-like day-to-day utility.
Security is commensurate with the estate: least privilege, patch hygiene, segmented access, and contained blast radius.
The platform is operable and rebuildable without tribal memory.
Self-hosting remains viable in money and scarce human attention, or the premium is explicit and accepted.
DEEP infrastructure remains secure, reachable, recoverable, sufficiently resourced, and capable of supporting declared services.

commitment.exit_plan: retire only with an accepted replacement infrastructure owner and preserved recovery path

entries.outcome: The fictional example service stays available to its declared users on <host-a> and <host-b>, demonstrating the service fulfilment folder shape.
